news.title: “We can’t just wait it out”: experts tout partnerships as antidote to compliance squeeze
news.summary_en: International student policy shifts across the big four are not "a cycle we can simply wait out” and will force universities to rethink how they recruit, partner and design learning, sector leaders argued in a panel on international pathways and compliance.
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: August applications for UK study visas fall 16% in just a year
news.summary_en: Concerns are mounting about the falling number of international students applying to study in the UK, with new government figures showing a marked drop off in visa applications.
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: Canada increases proof of funds requirement
news.summary_en: Canada has increased its proof of financial support for study permits in line with the cost of living.
news.author: Polly Nash

news.title: CAS issuances down 27% as UK visa refusals jump 30%, Enroly data shows
news.summary_en: Recruitment behaviours are changing, with South Asian and African countries the worst hit amid the UK's compliance squeeze, according to new data analysis from Enroly.
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: EC English halts new student arrivals worldwide this weekend
news.summary_en: EC English Language Centres has said it will not be able to accept students due to arrive at its worldwide schools this weekend.
news.author: Polly Nash

news.title: Scotland’s new minister stakes out a pro‑Erasmus, pro‑EU mobility agenda
news.summary_en: Barely 24 hours into the job, Scotland’s new minister for innovation, technology and tertiary education, Alyn Smith, used the EAIE conference in Glasgow to send a clear message to the international education sector that Scotland wants to be deeply plugged into European mobility and collaboration.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: US edtech nonprofit Technovation named PIEoneer of the year
news.summary_en: Technovation was recognised at The PIEoneer Awards 2026 for helping underrepresented young people develop technology-based solutions to challenges in their communities.
news.author: Abhishek Nair
